title: Molecular Gas Outflow in the Starburst Galaxy NGC 1482
question: What are the distribution, dynamics and energetics of molecular gas in the starburst-driven superwind of NGC 1482, and is the wind starburst driven?

data.arrays: 12-m array (TM, 43 antennas) and 7-m ACA (10 antennas), Cycle 7
data.sensitivity: CO 2.1 mJy/beam per 10.16 km/s; continuum 31 uJy/beam

what.value: Disk position angle -77 deg for mosaic setup

evidence.quote: at a position angle of $-77\ensuremath{^\circ}$ adopted from (cite: Sor19)

what.value: Outflow velocity of Halpha gas, mass and energy of ionized outflow

evidence.quote: (cite: Kew00) derived a lower value of 0.03 yr$^{-1}$.

recipe.method: CASA pipeline calibration, uvcontsub, joint TM+ACA tclean mosaic
key_parameters: natural weighting, 10.16 km/s channels (CO); Briggs robust 0.5, mfs (continuum)

recipe.goal: Moment maps and molecular gas mass
recipe.method: Smooth cube to twice beam, clip at 3 sigma as mask, integrate with immoments; mass from CO flux and X_CO
assumptions: X_CO=2.0e20 (standard) or 0.5e20 cm-2 (K km/s)-1; D=19.6 Mpc

recipe.goal: Continuum sources and star formation rate
recipe.method: imfit of sources; free-free SFR from 100 GHz flux
3DBarolo, 20 rings of 1.56"; PA and center fixed from K_S/CO; phase 1 for i and vsys, phase 2 for vrot and surface brightness
assumptions: Coplanar rings with uniform circular motion

recipe.goal: Outflow velocity from residuals and pv diagrams
recipe.method: Residual velocity = moment 1 minus model; v_w=|dv_p|/(2cos i) from pv cut dC

recipe.goal: Outflow mass, energy, mass outflow rate
recipe.method: M_w from outflow CO flux with low X_CO; E=Mv^2/2; Mdot=v M/h_z with h_z=1 kpc
assumptions: X_CO=0.5e20, alpha_CO=1; cylindrical outflow, constant velocity, uniform density

recipe.method: Compare E_w with supernova energy (xi~0.1), momentum; singular isothermal sphere escape velocity; inflow rate from halo clouds
assumptions: Singular isothermal sphere truncated at r_max

evidence.loc: 3.3 Continuum Emission and Star Formation Rate
3.3 Continuum Emission and Star Formation Rate

evidence.quote: the mean value was $i=76.1\ensuremath{^\circ}$ with a dispersion of $\sigma=2.4\ensuremath{^\circ}$
we get $v_\mathrm{esc}(r)\approx250\mathrm{-}390$ km s$^{-1}$ at $r=30.4\ensuremath{''}$ (2.9 kpc)

not_stated_but_needed: CO and continuum image sizes and cell sizes
Deconvolution thresholds, masks and clean parameters
Line-free channels for uvcontsub and fit order
Moment-map clipping rms and 3DBarolo input parameters (fit mode, weighting, normalization)
Exact velocity range and channel setup for cube
How the outflow CO flux (~70 Jy km/s) was separated from the disk
Details of K_S image fit region and H-alpha/X-ray image processing
score_reason: Data and main steps stated, but many imaging and modelling parameters and outflow extraction regions unspecified.
rediscovery_reason: Public Cycle 7 data, tclean plus 3DBarolo recipe, numeric results (inclination, Mdyn, outflow mass/rate).
